plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Computer Science Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 18, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7590/PublishedPdf). Total Units: 37; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path = 9 + 10 + 11 + 7 = 37 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 9 / 10 / 11 / 7 headers. Certificate of Achievement requires a grade of 'C' or better in each course. Choice slots: (1) Sem 2 Major Elective — a minimum of 6 units from the list (choose 3 units this semester): CISC 351, CISC 355, (CISD 357 OR CISP 357), (CISD 358 OR CISP 358), (CISD 359 OR CISP 359), CISN 303, CISP 401, CISP 457, CISS 300, CISS 310, CISW 327, CISW 400, CISW 410 — CISC 351 selected (first-listed, no listed prereq); (2) Sem 3: CISP 400 / CISP 401 Object Oriented Programming with C++ (4) — CISP 400 selected; (3) Sem 3 Major Elective — same list, choose 3 units not already completed — CISC 355 selected (first-listed not yet used); (4) Sem 4: CISP 440 / CISP 457 Discrete Structures for Computer Science (3) — CISP 440 selected: CISP 457 requires CISA 323 (not in plan) plus CISC 310 and one of 360/400/401, whereas CISP 440 requires CISP 400 or 401 (in-plan) plus MATH 372, a placement/prior-coursework prereq documented here. In-plan prereqs: CISC 324 requires CISC 323; CISP 350 and CISP 360 require CISP 301; CISP 310 requires CISP 301 and 360; CISP 400/401 require CISP 360; CISP 430 requires CISP 400 or 401 (CISP 400 in-plan); CISP 440 requires CISP 400 or 401 (CISP 400 in-plan) — all with grades of 'C' or better. The OR prereqs are handled by in-plan selection (CISP 400) and documented here; no one_of used. Further documented prereqs: CISP 440 also requires MATH 372 with a 'C' or better (placement); CISP 457 requires CISA 323 and CISC 310 with 'C' or better plus one of CISP 360/400/401; CISW 400 and 410 require CISP 301 and CISW 327; CISP 358/CISD 358/CISP 359/CISD 359 require CISP 357 or CISD 357. Semester-only offerings: CISN 303 spring only; CISP 457 fall only; CISW 400 fall only; CISW 410 spring only; CISP 430 spring only. Department contact: Bryan Krofchok (KrofchB@scc.losrios.edu) for course sequence adjustments. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
